summary: Implement a standardized unit testing framework by updating pom.xml with Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers, and JaCoCo, followed by creating base classes and isolated controller tests with mocking in the requested package structure.

plan.title: Add test dependencies to pom.xml
plan.description: Add spring-boot-starter-test, org.testcontainers:junit-jupiter, and jacoco-maven-plugin to pom.xml to support JUnit 5, Mockito, and Testcontainers.

plan.title: Configure plugins in pom.xml
plan.description: Configure maven-surefire-plugin for JUnit 5 compatibility and jacoco-maven-plugin for coverage reporting with a target of 95% for new code.

plan.title: Create package and base classes
plan.description: Create the requested package structure src/test/java/com/company/knowledgeassist and implement BaseUnitTest for Mockito setup and TestContainerBase for integration test examples.

plan.title: Implement HealthController unit test
plan.description: Create HealthControllerTest using @WebMvcTest and @MockBean to verify controller logic in isolation from HealthService.

plan.title: Update README.md
plan.description: Add a 'Testing' section to README.md documenting how to run tests using Maven and how to access JaCoCo coverage reports.

acceptance_criteria.description: pom.xml contains spring-boot-starter-test, org.testcontainers:junit-jupiter, and jacoco-maven-plugin.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Read pom.xml and confirm the presence of these dependencies and plugins.

acceptance_criteria.description: Package src/test/java/com/company/knowledgeassist and base classes exist.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Verify existence of BaseUnitTest.java and TestContainerBase.java in the specified package.

acceptance_criteria.description: HealthControllerTest mocks HealthService and verifies /api/health endpoint.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Verify content of HealthControllerTest.java for @MockBean usage and MockMvc assertions.

acceptance_criteria.description: JaCoCo configuration is present in pom.xml with execution goals for report generation.
README.md contains instructions for executing 'mvn test'.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Verify README.md has a 'Testing' section with the correct Maven command.

risks: Tests cannot be executed in the current environment because Java/Maven is not in the system path as per implementation report.
Testcontainers requires a functional Docker environment which may not be available on all development machines.
The futuristic Spring Boot version (4.1.0-SNAPSHOT) may result in dependency resolution issues.
